proposal.summary: Preserve field-specific supplementation as a skill and record the observed temporal-normalization failure as a memory. Retain the existing discovery guidance: all 35 stalled-search signals are compatible with honest empty discovery reports. Fetch failures had alternate-source coverage. The snapshot lacks final submission, but does not establish that the ongoing run abandoned finalization.

edits.title: Supplement missing fields with explicit evidence
edits.content: For multi-entity research, extract supported fields from authoritative overview sources into schema-validated records, retaining source URLs and exact quotations. Keep unsupported fields explicitly missing. Build follow-up queries only for missing entity-field pairs and group related evidence for extraction. Prefer sources that explicitly state the requested attribute; source prestige, birthplace, ancestry, residence, or institutional location cannot substitute for that statement. Preserve supported multiplicity and original-language quotations when translating values. A failed download is unavailable evidence: use an accessible alternative for the unresolved field, and do not cite the failed page or its search snippet as fetched support. Validate returned entity identities, coverage, and quote membership before merging supplemental cells by entity key. Treat successful extraction as intermediate work; complete semantic review and the required final output separately.

edits.title: Exact quotations do not resolve temporal ambiguity
edits.content: An extraction reproduced a nationality label exactly but converted its mixture of historical and present-day country terminology into an unqualified contemporary multiple-nationality claim. Quote membership verifies textual fidelity, not the full meaning of the normalized value. Before accepting a cell, check that the quoted passage supports the subject, requested attribute, every component of the value, and relevant time. Do not silently convert a historical state or a parenthetical modern geographic label into current citizenship. Preserve the source's qualification, seek explicit corroboration, or leave the unsupported component unresolved under the output contract.

additional_candidates.description: Schema-validated overview extraction exposed missing nationality fields; grouped biography extraction supplied explicit supplemental evidence, including multilingual and multiple-nationality statements.
An exact supporting quotation with mixed historical/current terminology was normalized into an unqualified contemporary multiple-nationality value.
A fallback URL selector reintroduced an excluded mirror, alternate-format fetching mostly repeated evidence, and a large biography fetch batch consumed substantial time.

decisions.reason: The self-check reports empty_output, with empty citations and constraint coverage. However, the trajectory ends at five completed subordinate extraction responses following code that requests this refinement; no subsequent root completion or terminal failure is recorded. The last completed worker iteration has null final_answer, which is expected during research. This establishes missing submission at this snapshot, not an observed failure to finalize a completed run. The base instructions already require serialization and readiness assignment. No additional finalization memory is justified without a terminal outcome.

All 35 occurrences were compared with their search results and discovery calls. Signals 0–8 concern overview hits whose titles/snippets did not name new laureates; their empty reports followed inspection. Signal 9 concerns an already-recorded entity during source recovery. Signals 10–34 concern field supplementation for the 25 entities already extracted into rows, so populated hits did not imply newly discovered entities. These searches produced useful sources despite zero new-entity reports. The existing memory explicitly permits honest empty reports for verification searches and forbids fabricated discoveries. Its usage and outcomes arrays are empty, providing no evidence of consistently harmful outcomes. Retain it unchanged rather than treating these signals as repeated placeholder failures.

All ten failures were reviewed: six HTTP access failures, three redirect loops, and one broken-pipe download error. Signal 35's mirror failure recovered through an official PDF, whose extracted rows passed quote assertions and were incorporated. Signals 36–44 affected biography sources, but the completed supplemental responses selected accessible alternatives for every affected entity: Smith, Henderson, Winter, Whittingham, Charpentier (two failed sources), List, MacMillan, and Stoddart. This supports field-level alternate-source coverage, not claims that failed endpoints were repaired or that an adaptive retry occurred. Preserve the reusable alternative-source procedure within the supplementation skill; do not blacklist domains or prescribe unsupported retries.

The overview extraction diagnostic records 25 missing nationality cells and no quote-membership errors; recovered PDF extraction adds supported rows. All five subsequent biography responses provide structured supplemental candidates using explicit field statements rather than birthplace or affiliation. Independent inspection of the recorded captures confirms quotation membership for all 140 populated extracted cells. This is a repeatable acquisition/extraction tactic, including multilingual and multiple-value evidence, but the snapshot does not demonstrate the planned aggregate validation, merge, or final submission. The skill preserves those boundaries and requires validation before merging.

The response in trajectory/76 turns a label combining a historical state and parenthetical modern terminology into an unqualified contemporary multiple-nationality value. Its quotation is an exact substring, so the planned membership check in trajectory/71 would not detect the lost qualification. The prompt already cautioned against historical/current conflation, yet this candidate remained ambiguous and no correction is recorded. Preserve the failure mode and require semantic and temporal support separately from quotation fidelity, without storing the task's answer facts.

The URL fallback in trajectory/8 fails to retain its mirror exclusion and selects a mirror that fails; a targeted search subsequently recovers an official PDF. The PDF sweep mostly duplicates already acquired fields, and the biography batch returns 75 results with nine failures after about 601 seconds. These are real efficiency signals, but no timeout or exhausted budget is shown, and alternate sources yielded useful supplementation. With two edits available, prioritize the demonstrated field-supplementation procedure and semantic normalization failure over a separate selector or batching entry. The skill already limits follow-up work to unresolved entity-field pairs.
